items.followUp: State two differences between liquids and gases.

rubric.why: Solids retain their shape, while gases take the shape of their container.
rubric.description: Compare the shapes of solids and gases.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a solid has a definite or fixed shape and a gas does not.

rubric.why: A solid has a fixed volume, whereas a gas expands to fill its container.
rubric.description: Compare the volumes of solids and gases.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a solid has a definite or fixed volume and a gas fills the whole container.

modelAnswer: A solid has a definite shape, whereas a gas has no fixed shape and takes the shape of its container.
A solid has a definite volume, whereas a gas expands to fill the whole container.

items.followUp: Compare an atom with a molecule.

rubric.why: A molecular ion is a bonded group of atoms carrying a net charge.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying a molecular ion as a bonded group of atoms with a net charge.

rubric.why: A molecule is a bonded group of atoms with no overall charge.
rubric.description: Define a molecule and state its charge.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a molecule is a group of bonded atoms that is electrically neutral.

rubric.why: A molecular ion's charge results from gaining or losing electrons; a molecule has no net charge.
rubric.description: Explain the charge difference between a molecular ion and a molecule.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking the molecular ion's charge to electron gain or loss and distinguishing it from a neutral molecule.

rubric.why: An example illustrates a molecular ion or a neutral molecule.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a valid example of a molecular ion or molecule.

modelAnswer: A molecular ion is a group of bonded atoms that carries a net positive or negative charge, for example, NH4+.
A molecule is a group of bonded atoms that is electrically neutral, for example, H2O.
A molecular ion becomes charged by gaining or losing electrons, whereas a molecule has no net charge.
